## Orientation

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/area-levels` on `phase/area-levels`.
Other tasks in this wave run in their own worktrees. Do not touch them.
Do not edit anything under `.canon/`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R14: `GET /api/areas` lists, for each area, the promoted ideas whose effort is placed in that area.
R27: The existing deep-link tests pass unchanged.
R29: In the Playwright test, a click on a seeded area card opens `#/area/<subject>`.

## Approach

Do not edit the tree. Run the phase checks through the real entry points and return the result. The Playwright run starts the real FastAPI server on a seeded store and drives the built UI in Chromium. Then run the deep-link tests, the frontend lint, type, test and build commands, and the Python lint, type and endpoint tests. Report each command and its result.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R14: `GET /api/areas` lists, for each area, the promoted ideas whose effort is placed in that area.
R27: The existing deep-link tests pass unchanged.
R29: In the Playwright test, a click on a seeded area card opens `#/area/<subject>`.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants:
- Hash routing only. One served document.
- The product index and the area page write nothing.
- An idea never renders among the efforts.
- The URL decides the selected effort.

Assumptions:
- Phase `effort-area-link` is merged, so `area` is on every snapshot effort.
- The Home screen needs no change other than the chip.
- The Playwright seed store can hold an area and a placement.

Decisions:
- landing-product-index: #/ shows the product index, one card for each area; the effort Home moves to #/effort/<name>
- rail-siblings: The left rail lists the siblings of the current level
- area-needs-read-only: Needs-you on the area page is a read-only list that links to the effort
- area-join-client-side: Group efforts in the browser from the snapshot; the backend adds promoted ideas to the area of their effort's placement
